prerequisites.reason: Backpropagation is a training algorithm specifically for neural networks.
Activation functions are integral to the functioning of neural networks.
Loss functions are used to evaluate the performance of neural networks.
Gradient descent is used to minimize loss functions.
Gradient flow is essential for the backpropagation process.
Model evaluation often involves assessing the results of optimization via gradient descent.
Understanding the shape and parameters is crucial for designing neural networks.
